pr.title: feat(conport): entity-relationship write API with link_items/get_linked_items MCP tools
pr.body: Implements the entity_relationships write surface: POST /api/relationships creates a relationship between two items with a validated relationship_type; GET /api/relationships?workspace_id&source_id&source_type retrieves edges; DELETE /api/relationships/{id} removes an edge with 404 on miss. Adds link_items and get_linked_items MCP tools registered in both server.py and conport_mcp_stdio.py. Redis cache invalidation clears relationship-keyed entries on write/delete. relationship_type enum = builds_upon, validates, extends, implements, depends_on, supersedes per Decision Gate 2 default.
